manifest_purpose: Reproducibility seed for architecture_profile.json (PF-6 of MEMIT-COMPAT-PROTO-1). Block 1 outputs only; Block 2 (RunPod dry-run) and Block 3 (persistent state) populated in Session 2.3.

fact.prompt: Michael Jordan plays the sport of
fact.subject: Michael Jordan

pinned_versions.kaggle_environment_pinning: manual override of 'always-latest' default; joint 4.x-line stack pinned

edit_config.device_map: explicit (Path B): cuda:0 holds layers 0-13 + embedding + ln_f + lm_head; cuda:1 holds layers 14-27

memit_nethook_p1_signature_and_inputs_sy.rationale: transformers >= 4.36 forwards GPT-J MLP via kwargs; legacy positional-args-only hook signature returns empty inputs tuple, breaking MEMIT's input-capture

memit_nethook_p2_with_kwargs_registratio.rationale: PyTorch >= 2.0 register_forward_hook with_kwargs=True flag required to receive keyword arguments in hook signature

memit_solve_cpu_offload_p3_prime.rationale: 16384^2 FP64 covariance promotion exceeds Kaggle 2x T4 cuda:0 envelope; CPU offload moves cov.cpu().double() and torch.linalg.solve to host RAM; ~30 sec wall time per layer, ~3 min total

tokenizer_pad_token_alias.rationale: GPT-J inherits GPT-2's tokenizer which has no pad_token by default; MEMIT generate_fast utility batches multiple context prompts with padding

explicit_device_map.rationale: device_map='auto' places lm_head on cuda:1 to balance memory; MEMIT compute_z manually accesses lm_head.weight as lm_w and performs cross-device gather which fails. Explicit map co-locates lm_head, ln_f, embedding, edit range on cuda:0

unmount_in_place_copy_only.target_location: Cell 8 (canonical notebook); framework write engine universally
unmount_in_place_copy_only.rationale: setattr-replace of nn.Parameter desynchronizes visible parameter state from forward-pass-used parameter state under accelerate hooks. In-place Tensor.copy_() preserves Parameter object identity and all external references

overlay.size_calculation: 6 fc_out tensors of shape (4096, 16384) FP32 = 6 * 4096 * 16384 * 4 bytes / 1e6 MB

kaggle_smoke_test.tf_factory_warnings_observed: Yes - benign; Kaggle bundles TensorFlow alongside PyTorch; first cell after kernel start emits cuFFT/cuDNN/cuBLAS factory-registration errors. Non-blocking.
kaggle_smoke_test.transformers_attn_bias_warning: Yes - benign; legacy attn.bias / attn.masked_bias buffers in 2021-vintage GPT-J checkpoint are dropped silently by current GPTJForCausalLM class which computes causal mask at runtime. Mathematically equivalent.
